*How Kudos works* :taco:
• Mention teammates and add :taco: to your message: `@ana @ben :taco::taco: thanks for the release!`
• Each :taco: gives one kudos to *every* person mentioned. You can give 5 per day.
• React with :taco: on a message to give its author one kudos.
• The bot answers with messages of different rarities. Collect them all!
`/kudos me` what you can give today · `/kudos top` weekly leaderboard
`/kudos quests` your weekly quests
`/kudos level` your level · `/kudos coins` your Hog coins
<https://kudos.example/me?ws=T1|Open the Kudos dashboard>
